text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky and King Halo were playing shogi in the classroom. The state of the board was---

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I see it! Checkmate is next!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh boy... I'm at my wit's end.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! All that's left is to push through to the end!
The "King" shall watch from a safe distance above!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "A comfortable victory—this is what it means to be first-class! Accept your defeat gracefully, Sky-san!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...A first-rate king watching safely from above, huh?
Is that really the right thing to do, I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...What are you trying to say?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Nothing, really? I was just wondering if 'merely winning' is enough for someone as first-class as you."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Y-You won't fool me.
You always, always do this...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, why don't you listen closely?
Can't you hear the voices of the soldiers?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...This is a battlefield where we vie for supremacy—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, to think my strategy would be broken...
Is this... the end for me...?

text_block_list.name: King's Silver General
text_block_list.text:
The enemy forces are on the verge of collapse!
Now, let King deliver the finishing blow!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A king sits upon their throne!
There is no need for me to dirty my own hands!

text_block_list.name: King's Gold General
text_block_list.text:
However, the enemy is dispirited—now is our chance!
Settle this with your own hands and show them your majesty!

text_block_list.name: King's Army
text_block_list.text: Show us... the King's majestic glory!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ………………D-Do you really want to see it that badly?

text_block_list.name: King's Army
text_block_list.text:
King! King! King!
Our ruler! The great king! A first-class king!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. ...Hehehe.
Heheheheh...!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Very well, I'll show you!
The majestic, first-rate valor of the King herself—!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, burn this into your eyes!
I hereby grant you the right to pass this tale down to your descendants!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
T-This is bad!
All forces, retreat! Retreaaat—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Or so it seemed.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: All right, dark horses, it's your time to shine~!

text_block_list.name: Sky's Legion
text_block_list.text: Uwooooo---!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? N-No way!?
I'm completely surrounded in an instant...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Too baaad. Now then, King,
is it your turn to show some grace next?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "...Don't speak such nonsense. Grace in defeat? That is utterly unbecoming of a first-rate monarch!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, if it's my head you want, come and take it!
Though you best be prepared for a counterstrike of your own!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha. I knew you'd say that~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Still, I win~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the very last moment, Seiun Sky
brilliantly baited out King Halo's shot,
completely turning the tide of the battle...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ngggggh...!!
Next time... Next time for sure...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely, definitely gonna win this, aaaaall the waaaay—!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oops, there she goes.
...Still, that's King for ya, never changing.
choice_data_list: That indomitable spirit is tough to deal with.
That indomitable spirit is tough to deal with, huh.
Your pride is your weak point.
Your pride is your weak point, you know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oops, there she goes.
...Still, that's King for ya, never changing.
choice_data_list: That indomitable spirit is tough to deal with.
That indomitable spirit is tough to deal with, huh.
Your pride is your weak point.
Your pride is your weak point, you know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Indeed.
Taking that head-on is quite troublesome—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Alright, that's enough moping around!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Accept my next challenge, Sky-san!!
Next is chess!! A match of chess!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even though Seiun Sky was dragged along by King Halo afterward and completely worn out, she seemed to be enjoying herself somewhere deep down.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that's what I thought at first too, but...
I'm not sure if you'd really call that a weakness, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, but even if it looks like a weakness to others,
maybe it's not like that for me—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Maybe I can use this for some kind of strategy someday? ...Ahaha."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, Seiun Sky gazed in the direction
King Halo had left, offering a meaningful smile...
